name: Iron Lung
author: Cell
summary: Offers the Wine 11 and DXMT configuration tested for Iron Lung's freeze after switching apps.
useWhen: Iron Lung stops updating after you switch back from another Mac app.

options.title: Prefer Wine 11 with DXMT
options.help: Install a Wine 11 engine with DXMT first. Use this in a separate container if other games need the current engine. Changing Wine engines stops the apps running in that container.

notes: Wine 11 (PK_DXMT revision 1) kept the camera working after repeated app switches in a controlled test. The flashes during camera movement are still under investigation.
